component.name: Peekaboo
component.summary: Unlock your laptop by looking at it

description.p: Peekaboo is face unlock for laptops with an infrared (Windows Hello) camera. It works for the lock screen, the login screen, sudo and system prompts.

ul.li: Infrared strobe, attention and head-turn checks against pictures and screens
Both cameras check each other while you register; only infrared is stored
Animations that follow your head, with a studio to make them yours
Templates encrypted with a key sealed to the TPM; no pictures are kept
